title: Claimant app redesign: production-grade guided FNOL
story: As a policyholder reporting a loss on my phone I want a calm, clear, branded step-by-step experience so that I trust the insurer and finish my claim in minutes
acceptance: Uses fx-app-shell and the design system from S6-EXP-01 (docs/design/design-system.md) and places <fx-demo-bar> (S6-EXP-02) in the shell's demo slot; the old dev sign-in form is gone when the bar is present

Mobile-first guided flow: a welcome screen with the tenant brand and what to expect, a progress indicator, one focused question or group per step with large touch targets, inline validation, the last name + ZIP holder step and vehicle picker as a polished card, a review screen, and a confirmation screen with the claim number, what happens next as a timeline, and the claim status view; English and Spanish
Dates, statuses and enums via src/web/shared/format.js (no raw ISO timestamps or snake_case on screen)

All existing claimant behaviour still works: tests/ui/claimant.test.mjs and tests/unit/web/claimant/ updated to the new DOM and passing; tests/ui/deployed-host.test.mjs passing; full npm test no new failures

Screenshots written by the UI test: docs/design/screens/claimant-welcome, -question, -vehicle, -review, -confirmation at 390x844 and claimant-welcome at 1440x900; the reviewer opens them and rejects anything that looks unstyled or crude
brief: Compare with docs/design/before/claimant.png. Read docs/design/design-system.md and src/web/shared/kitchen-sink.html first. Do not edit src/web/shared/ (post a request to the experience hub if a shared component needs a change and work around it locally).

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; claimant UI/deployed-host/unit tests pass (58/58), screenshots polished; full suite failures (CSR guard/search, demo-bar switch flake passes on rerun) are CSR-owned/flaky, not claimant.
